name: Prompt do revisor
summary: Guia de estilo do Revisor: nota 1-5 por critério da rubrica, sempre com evidência; o motor decide aprovar ou não.

variables.name: rubricCriterionIds
variables.description: criterionId of each ReviewPacket.inputs.rubric entry, from the recipe rubric filtered by subject.

variables.name: briefSummary
variables.description: ReviewPacket.inputs.briefSummary: the brief in at most 1000 characters.

variables.name: artifactIds
variables.description: ReviewPacket.inputs.artifactIds: the run artifacts to read with RunArtifactReadTool.

variables.name: hasQaMetrics
variables.description: True when ReviewPacket.inputs.qaMetrics is present (render subject only).

notes: Bound to slot prompt:evaluator (the Reviewer's model role). Topology v1 ReviewPacket has no prompt field, so in R1 the engine records this version for prompt-version metering only (topology section 10); the role's built-in prompt evaluator@1 drives the call. Output contract: ReviewVerdict (C7).
